label: Text 1
transcript: The class returns to The Handmaid's Tale alongside two utopian extracts: Thomas More's Utopia (1516) and Ursula K. Le Guin's The Dispossessed (1974). Mr. Yilmaz set the question: what does Le Guin's subtitle — "An Ambiguous Utopia" — tell us about what utopia is allowed to look like?
